title_zh: 公安机关严厉打击编造传播涉汛涉灾网络谣言
title_en: Public Security Organs Crack Down on Online Rumors Regarding Floods and Disasters
summary_zh: 公安机关采取严厉措施，打击在网络上编造和传播涉汛涉灾谣言的行为，以维护网络秩序和社会稳定。
summary_en: Public security organs are taking strict measures to crack down on the fabrication and dissemination of online rumors related to floods and disasters to maintain cyber order and social stability.
